name: VSEP washing membrane package

design.materialOfConstruction: PVDF- or PP-lined construction, or dual-laminate FRP
design.operatingPhilosophy: Low transmembrane pressure operation to avoid compressible cake formation; CIP / flush connections; skid includes CIP capability

operatingEnvelope.washEndpoint: Wash until permeate conductivity < 100–200 µS/cm and pH ≈ 5 meet downstream spec; multiple diafiltration cycles may be required
operatingEnvelope.operatingMode: A-400 onward continuous or semi-continuous at the design rates of Table 3.3-1, with surge/hold at the batch-to-continuous boundary (T-501)
operatingEnvelope.washLiquorTargets: pH 5.0 ± 0.2; SO₄²⁻ ≤ 1 mg/L; Mn non-detect; conductivity < 10 µS/cm on the wash liquor
operatingEnvelope.membraneTemperatureLimits: Synder V0.2: 25 °C at pH < 2, 50 °C above pH 2

reviewFindings: The local temperature-sheet PDF skips FEED-PFD-0400. The inherited register page 9 is a full-document reference, not an available excerpt. No approved source revision is established.
Model screening identifies an eight-module capacity shortfall and differing solids assumptions. Layout volumes, flux and module count are not qualified ratings.
The model has two parallel trains of two feed-pump stages. Supplier drawing and utility-sheet pump counts remain unreconciled; no duty/standby allocation is asserted.
Cleaning chemistry, product isolation, vent compatibility, drain receiving pressure/invert, instrument tags and protective settings remain unqualified.
Dimensions, model screening inputs and package layouts do not establish approved engineering values.
